app.name: Salat
app.tagline: Learn the prayer, word by word
learn.title: The prayer, step by step
learn.subtitle: %d steps — read them in your own words, then in Arabic
practice.title: Passive review
practice.hint: Let it run. Each step stays long enough to sink in.
settings.widget.title: Home screen widget
settings.widget.hint: Add the Salat widget to your home screen: touch and hold the wallpaper, tap +, then search for Salat. It cycles through the positions on its own.
settings.disclaimer: This app follows the practice agreed upon by the four Sunni schools. Where they differ, the difference is noted rather than settled. It is a memorisation aid, not a substitute for a teacher.
onboarding.1.title: Welcome
onboarding.1.body: Salat teaches you what to say during the prayer — in Arabic, spelled out the way you read, and translated into your language.
onboarding.2.title: Step by step
onboarding.2.body: Fourteen steps, from the intention to the closing greeting. Open one and you get the posture, the Arabic, the pronunciation and the meaning.
onboarding.3.title: Then you get asked
onboarding.3.body: The Memorise tab turns the steps you have read into short rounds of questions: which line comes next, which word is missing, which words go with a position.
onboarding.4.title: Even on your home screen
onboarding.4.body: Add the widget and a position comes back to you throughout the day, without opening anything.
onboarding.5.title: You're ready
onboarding.5.body: Take your time. One step a day is already a lot.
audio.title: Recitation
audio.none: No recitation was recorded for this step — record yourself and check against the pronunciation above.
audio.none.listen: No recitation was recorded for this step: follow the written pronunciation above.
audio.mine.title: My recitation
audio.denied: The microphone is switched off for Salat. Turn it on in iOS Settings to record yourself.
audio.compare.hint: Both traces share one time axis: you can see where you go faster, where you stop. It shows the shape, not whether it is right — for that, an ear.
settings.audio.credits: Recitations of Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas from everyayah.com. The rest of the prayer is not Qur'an and has no such recording — those steps carry no reciter.
revise.subtitle: Pick a way to work. More tools will land here.
revise.tool.vocal.title: Voice practice
revise.tool.vocal.body: Listen to a reciter, record yourself, put the two side by side.
revise.gallery.subtitle: Pick a step to work on.
vocal.tap_hint: Tap a line to work on it.
settings.reminders.hint: One notification a day, naming a step you have not learned yet. Nothing is sent while the app is open, and it stops on its own after two silent weeks.
settings.reminders.denied: Notifications are switched off for Salat. Turn them on in iOS Settings to be reminded.
notif.title: Salat
notif.body.1: %@ is still waiting for you. Two minutes is enough.
notif.body.3: Pick up where you left off: %@.
notif.body.done: You have learned all fourteen steps. Go through them once so they stay.
onboarding.language.title: Your language
onboarding.language.body: We took the one your phone is set to. Change it here if you would rather read another; Settings can change it again at any time.
analytics.title: My progress
analytics.subtitle: The days you worked on it, what you hold, and what is still waiting.
analytics.calendar.title: Your study days
analytics.calendar.hint: One square per day over the last thirteen weeks. A square fills as soon as you open a step.
analytics.due.title: Go back to this
analytics.due.hint: Started, then left aside the longest — first. This is what the daily reminder names.
analytics.due.empty: Nothing waiting. Everything has been seen recently.
analytics.learned.title: What you have learned
analytics.learned.empty: Nothing marked as known yet. Open a step and say where you stand.
analytics.timeline.title: These last days
analytics.timeline.empty: Your history starts the first time you open a step.
notif.body.learning: %@ is still in progress. Two minutes are enough.
notif.body.review: Go over %@ once so it stays.
memorize.ready: steps read so far. A round asks eight questions about them.
memorize.strength.title: What comes back
revise.tool.drill.title: Exercises
revise.tool.drill.body: Eight questions built from the steps you have read.
drill.q.posture: Which words go with this position?
drill.done.title: Round finished
drill.done.score: %d right out of %d. What you missed comes back first next time.
drill.empty: Nothing to ask yet. Open a step in Learn and say where you stand with it: the exercises are built from what you have already read.
